explanation: The `_AppManager.list` method calls `_get_project(self.api_client)` without passing a `project_id`, so it uses the default `LIGHTNING_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID`, but the pagination loop accumulates all pages into `apps` yet the final `console.print` renders only `resp.lightningapps` (the last page) instead of the fully accumulated `apps` list.
